description: Automatically switch airplane mode on a schedule Features • Flexible schedules. One-off or repeating on the days you choose. • Overnight schedules. Schedules can carry over to the next day. • Full control. Skip, postpone, pause or end your schedules. • Wi-Fi control. Off when a schedule starts, back on when it ends. • Safe by default. Ending a schedule undoes only what it changed; anything you change yourself stays. • Notifications. Quiet notifications before, during and after a schedule. • No internet access, ads or tracking. Note: This app needs Shizuku, or Sui on a rooted phone.
